js: 'Agents as a list beside the detail (modern design WP6): the split view at a wide window (the status page, a click selects, the arrows move the selection, a read answered late after the selection moved on is dropped (the page holds the docs librarian's answer 1.5 s), the handle resizes and keeps its width), the detail's tabs carrying the list's search, a re-read (Enable, then Disable from the menu, which it puts back) moving the list row and the hero but leaving the config field and the manifest editor with its unsaved text in place, the search (/ and Ctrl+F focus it, Esc clears it, a second Esc goes back to the list), deep links (a tab path selects its row and shows its tab, the old ?tab= link lands on the tab path), the header tabs, a dirty change in the mail labeler config (the accent dot, the save toast, the guard asking when another row is picked, Ctrl+S saving, the saved value read back after a reload, then put back), and the narrow window (one pane at a time, the back button). It SAVES the mail labeler config: run it on a dev copy, never on production. Nothing starts a run or a container. Run: scripts/ui-drive.py scripts/drive/agents-split.json --dsf 1.25 --token-file <dir>.token --base http://<addr>'
